site.name: Example Estuary
site.context: Use this folder as the safe starter for a new monitoring rollout without affecting Padstow.

programme.operationalLesson: New projects need a clear home for identity, area setup, and scan metadata before the first repeat comparison exists.
programme.consolidationGoal: Use the same folders, routing, and metadata shape as Padstow without inheriting Padstow-specific text or assets.

workflow.title: Define the project
workflow.copy: Set the project metadata, public route, and reporting tone in project.json.

workflow.title: Add monitoring areas
workflow.copy: List the initial monitoring areas in areas.json so the shared UI can render them.

workflow.title: Load the first scan
workflow.copy: Add the opening survey round in scans.json and wire any available assets.

workflow.title: Unlock change monitoring
workflow.copy: Once a second comparable survey exists, the comparison features can be populated.
